chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Ali ibn Ibrahim from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus ibn Abd al-Rahman from Hisham ibn al-Hakam, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'Let one of you adorn himself on Friday by bathing, applying perfume, grooming his beard, and wearing his cleanest clothes. Let him prepare for Friday prayer, and let tranquility and dignity be upon him on that day. Let him perform his worship to his Lord well, and do as much good as he can, for indeed Allah the Exalted looks upon the earth to multiply the good deeds.'
ai.seo_question: What are the recommended acts of adornment and etiquette for Friday according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) prescribes a holistic preparation for Friday, combining external adornment (ghusl, grooming, clean attire) with internal serenity (sakina) to honor the day of congregational prayer. This practice reflects the Shia emphasis on Friday as a weekly spiritual renewal, where physical cleanliness serves as a vessel for divine attention, encouraging believers to maximize good deeds through heightened devotion and dignity.
